title: Ballad playing on trombone and Goodbye Rose
summary: Ballad trombone existed early; he remembers a beautiful trombone solo on Goodbye Rose by a man he cannot name.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: But ballad playing, now, that wouldn't have been around when you started, in that sense. Would it?
Sure. Yes. I remember a long while ago, a trombone player, I don't remember who he was... There was a piece called "Goodbye, Rose." And it was just a beautiful trombone solo this guy played.
Yeah. That was a beautiful number.
But you have no recollection of who it was.
I think that quartets used to sing it years ago. Quartets. Because it was just a 16-measure thing. In fact, I remember that sound of the trombone playing it. It was beautiful.
